description: Code-behind for StartExam.aspx page handling exam selection, course loading based on user session, and navigation in an online examination system.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam.aspx page managing exam initiation and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, loads course options based on user semester.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Starts the selected exam, checks for available questions, and sets session variables.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exam from GridView, checks if already taken, and initiates exam.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exam from GridView, checks if already taken, and initiates exam.
